overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for endgame snapshots and optimizing Monte Carlo convergence logic. This batch ensures 100% reproducibility of the 5,500-tick campaign state with minimal memory footprint, closing all identified gaps in simulation fidelity and automation efficiency.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<uint8_t, 4096> for static buffer. Implement bitwise packing for tick counters (16-bit), entity IDs (12-bit), and status flags (4-bit). No dynamic allocation. Use constexpr for table generation. Ensure strict little-endian serialization for cross-platform determinism.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compresses 5,500-tick state to <2KB. 2. Decompression is bit-exact identical to original. 3. Zero heap allocations during compress/decompress cycle. 4. Passes all 16,500 footstep verification checks.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load times and smaller save files, improving responsiveness in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence for Endgame States
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement early-exit condition for Monte Carlo iterations when variance < 1e-6. Use fixed-point arithmetic for 16,500 footstep logs. Cache intermediate probability distributions in static thread-local storage. Limit iterations to 1000 max for endgame stability.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Convergence achieved in <500 iterations for stable endgame states. 2. 100% survival rate maintained across 1000 test runs. 3. No floating-point drift in 5,500-tick simulation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks and more predictable physics outcomes in complex endgame scenarios.
